questions.question: In which year did Mihir Sen create history by being the only man to swim the five oceans in one calendar year?
questions.questionHtml: In which year did Mihir Sen create history by being the only man to swim the five oceans in one calendar year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1966.

Key Points

  • Mihir Sen, an Indian long-distance swimmer, became the first man to swim across the five major oceans within one calendar year in 1966.
  • He successfully swam the Palk Strait (India-Sri Lanka), the Strait of Gibraltar (Europe-Africa), the Dardanelles (Turkey), the Bosporus (Turkey), and the Panama Canal (Central America) during this remarkable feat.
  • This achievement established Mihir Sen as one of the world's most accomplished open-water swimmers and brought global recognition to Indian swimming.
  • He became the only person to achieve this extraordinary accomplishment in a single calendar year, demonstrating tremendous endurance and resilience.
  • Mihir Sen was awarded the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan by the Indian government for his outstanding contributions to sports.

Additional Information

  • Open-water swimming: This is a type of swimming conducted in outdoor bodies of water, such as oceans, lakes, and rivers, and requires exceptional physical stamina and mental strength.
  • Palk Strait: A strait between Tamil Nadu in India and the Jaffna District of Sri Lanka, known for its challenging currents and shallow waters.
  • Strait of Gibraltar: A narrow strait that connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates Europe from Africa, known for its strong tidal currents.
  • Panama Canal: An artificial waterway in Panama that connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, presenting unique challenges for swimmers due to its controlled locks and currents.
  • Mihir Sen's achievements are often compared to those of global swimming legends, making him a pioneer in Indian sports and a source of inspiration for athletes worldwide.

questions.question: In 2016 Rio Olympics, Indian gymnast Dipa Karmakar attempted the most dangerous vault known as:
questions.questionHtml: In 2016 Rio Olympics, Indian gymnast Dipa Karmakar attempted the most dangerous vault known as:
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is Produnova.

  • In 2016 Rio Olympics, Indian gymnast Dipa Karmakar attempted the most dangerous vault known as Produnova.
  • Dipa Karmakar created history by qualifying for the Vaults Final at the Rio Olympics 2016.
  • She became the first female gymnast in India to qualify for an event.
  • She was already the first Indian female gymnast to win an Olympic berth and the first Indian gymnast to qualify in 52 years for the Olympics.
  • She rose to prominence at the 2014 Commonwealth Games where she won bronze, making her the first Indian female gymnast in the history of the games to do so.
  • In her first rotation scoring 14,860, Dipa performed her signature vault event and secured eighth place to qualify her for the final.
  • In uneven bars, she scored 11.666 and 12.866 in beam balance and 12.033 in floor exercises, both scores worthy of a champion.

Important Points

  • Known to be an extremely dangerous vault, only five gymnasts in the world have attempted Pradunova in competition.
  • It consists of a front handspring and two front somersaults, usually called 'The Death Vault'. Named after the first person to complete the vault in 1999, Yelena Produnova, this vault is one of the hardest vaults to carry out.

questions.question: Vijender Singh has represented India in Olympics for how many times?
questions.questionHtml: Vijender Singh has represented India in Olympics for how many times?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 3.

Key Points

  • Vijender Singh has represented India in the Olympics for a total of three times.
  • He participated in the 2004 Athens Olympics, 2008 Beijing Olympics, and the 2012 London Olympics.
  • Vijender Singh is a celebrated Indian boxer who has made significant contributions to the sport in India.
  • He is notable for winning India's first-ever Olympic medal in boxing, which he achieved in the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

Additional Information

  • Olympics Overview
    • The Olympics are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.
    • The modern Olympic Games were first held in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
    • The Olympics are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
    • The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is responsible for organizing the Games and overseeing the host city's preparations.
  • Vijender Singh's Achievements
    • Vijender Singh Beniwal, born on October 29, 1985, is an Indian professional boxer and former amateur boxer.
    • He won a bronze medal in the middleweight category at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, making him the first Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal.
    • Vijender has also won medals at the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games, adding to his impressive list of achievements.
    • He turned professional in 2015 and has since continued to make a mark in the professional boxing circuit.
  • Boxing in the Olympics
    • Boxing has been a part of the Olympic Games since its inclusion in the 1904 St. Louis Games.
    • The competition is divided into different weight categories, and boxers compete in a knockout format to win medals.
    • Olympic boxing matches are typically shorter than professional bouts, consisting of three three-minute rounds.
    • The scoring system is based on the number of clean punches landed, and judges decide the winner if there is no knockout.

questions.question: Devendra Jhajharia won which medal/place in World Para Athletics Grand Prix?
questions.questionHtml: Devendra Jhajharia won which medal/place in World Para Athletics Grand Prix?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Silver

Key Points

  • Devendra Jhajharia won the Silver medal in the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2022.
  • He is a renowned Indian Paralympic javelin thrower and has achieved numerous accolades in his career.
  • Jhajharia is the first Indian Paralympian to win two gold medals at the Paralympics.
  • His achievements have significantly contributed to the visibility and recognition of para-athletes in India.

Additional Information

  • Devendra Jhajharia was born on 10th June 1981 in Rajasthan, India.
  • He lost his left hand due to an accidental electrocution when he was eight years old.
  • Despite his disability, he pursued sports and excelled in javelin throw.
  • He has been honored with several awards including the Padma Shri and the Padma Bhushan, India's fourth and third highest civilian awards respectively.
  • Jhajharia's journey is an inspiration to many aspiring athletes, showcasing the power of determination and resilience.

questions.question: Bhakti Pradeep Kulkarni is associated with ________.
questions.questionHtml: Bhakti Pradeep Kulkarni is associated with ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is chess.

Key Points

  • Bhakti Pradeep Kulkarni is a renowned Indian chess player who has made significant contributions to the sport.
  • She has represented India in numerous international chess tournaments, showcasing her skills and bringing laurels to the country.
  • Bhakti has achieved several accolades in her chess career, including national and international titles.
  • She continues to inspire young chess enthusiasts in India with her dedication and achievements in the game of chess.

Additional Information

  • Chess:
    • Chess is a two-player strategy board game played on an 8x8 grid known as a chessboard.
    • Each player begins with 16 pieces: one king, one queen, two rooks, two knights, two bishops, and eight pawns.
    • The objective of the game is to checkmate the opponent's king, which means the king is in a position to be captured ("in check") and there is no legal move to escape the threat.
    • Chess is believed to have originated in India during the Gupta Empire, where its early form was known as Chaturanga.
    • The game has a rich history and has been recognized as a sport by the International Olympic Committee.
    • FIDE (Fédération Internationale des Échecs) is the international governing body for chess, which organizes world championships and other major tournaments.
  • Notable Chess Tournaments:
    • The Chess World Championship is the highest accolade in the sport, determining the world's best chess player.
    • The Candidates Tournament is held to determine the challenger for the World Chess Championship.
    • Other prestigious tournaments include the Chess Olympiad, the Tata Steel Chess Tournament, and the Grand Chess Tour.

questions.question: In the context of tennis, what is the nationality of Steffi Graf?
questions.questionHtml: In the context of tennis, what is the nationality of Steffi Graf?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Germany.

Key Points

  • Stefanie Maria "Steffi" Graf (born 14 June 1969) is a German former professional tennis player.
  • She was ranked world No. 1 for a record 377 weeks (more than 7 years) and won 22 Grand Slam singles titles, which ranks second since the introduction of the Open Era in 1968 and third all-time behind Margaret Court and Serena Williams.
  • Graf was ranked world No. 1 by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) for a record 377 total weeks—the longest period for which any player, male or female, has held the number-one ranking since the WTA and the Association of Tennis Professionals began issuing rankings.

Additional Information

  • The headquarters of the Women's Tennis Association is St. Petersburg, Florida, United States.
  • The headquarters of The International Tennis Federation (ITF) is in London, England.
  • The President of the International Tennis Federation is David Haggerty.
